authority_basis.summary: Record the deck eigenspaces and cyclic occurrence assembly of the corrected W6 layer.

operations.title: The top four-site Tate layer has a forty-dimensional Kummer sector
operations.body: The corrected W6 cokernel splits by deck character. Five-mark terms contribute 4 invariant and zero anti-invariant dimensions; six-mark terms contribute 10 invariant and 2 anti-invariant. Across seven free C4 term orbits the total is 232+ plus 40-, with regular C4 character in each sector.

operations.title: W6 deck-eigenmatrix and cyclic assembly audit
operations.body: The checker constructs invariant all-pair incidence and anti-invariant split-pair/off-branch matrices termwise, verifies their cokernels sum to Entry 1189, and assembles exact profile and C4 characters.

operations.title: Benincasa identifies the four-site top Kummer packet
operations.body: Entry 1190 decomposes corrected W6. Five-mark terms: 4+ and 0-. Six-mark terms: 10+ and 2-. Across seven free C4 orbits the top layer is 232 invariant plus 40 anti-invariant Kummer dimensions, with characters (232,0,0,0) and (40,0,0,0). This is fully typed coefficient data on the existing carrier. Next is the possible Gauss-Manin extension from the five elliptic pair systems into the local 2-dimensional Kummer quotient of six-mark terms.
